clause.regulation: UERC (Terms and Conditions for Determination of Multi Year Tariff) Regulations, 2021 (the order calls them 'UERC Tariff Regulations, 2021')
clause.excerpt: 14. Sharing of Gains and Losses on account of Controllable factors (1) The approved aggregate gain and loss to the Applicant on account of controllable factors shall be dealt with in the following manner: a) 1/3rd of such gain or loss shall be passed on as a rebate or allowed to be recovered in tariffs over such period as may be specified in the Order of the Commission; b) The balance amount of such gain or loss may be utilized or absorbed by the Applicant.
